title: Certify source-bound P112 caller coverage for the (6,4) cell
body:
## Summary

Add a source-bound reconciliation of the historical P112 TWOSIDE `(6,4)` cell against six pinned published contracts.

```text
7,546 original multisets
  69 historical BK/BK7 survivors
  62 certified by the fixed six-contract inventory
   7 uncertified by that inventory, with failed cut/rank contracts retained
```

The new contribution is the exact caller composition and coverage certificate. Prior exclusions retain their credit and are not claimed as new results. The seven rows are not a claim about the complete current public frontier.

`PROOF.md` proves deletion, common-cut restriction, literal monotonicity and seven-flat quotient implications. `RESULT.json` records every row, all contract attempts, exact indexed assignment counts and witnesses. Eight predecessor payloads are retained verbatim, so fresh CI and direct export need no pending PR Git objects. Fixed path, usage, schema and hash checks prevent source relabelling.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154, Nick Petalas/PR3262/3205/3260/3186/3192/3253 and the retained E8/P112, root-simplex, SMALL2/Pencil and joaqcoo lineage. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19003789).

## Evidence

- **Before:** the historical count 69 did not identify which literal callers met the published shortening contracts.
  **After:** the retained source filter and separate transcription agree on all 7,546 multisets. Separate endpoint-first and small-first implementations agree on all 69 rows, every successful assignment count and each failed minimum-cut boundary.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes all three commands and twelve controls, including a real corrupted-receipt replay failure, non-prefix assignment, deletion-dimension and input-inventory controls. Ruff and formatting pass.
- The exact committed read-only Git-free export passes all three commands under optimized CPython 3.13.16. All 25 final package files and eight retained source blobs match. The designated scoped read-only peer receipt is retained in `REVIEW.json` before publication.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-b6-t4-reconciliation
```

The predecessor theorems, capacities, distance, Weyl geometry and historical census suites remain conditional and unrun. Omitted alpha/cover rules and actual coefficient/physical/supplier obligations are unclaimed. No full C5, decoder-floor, kappa or selected-frontier update follows. Hosted CI and human or proof-kernel review are separate. Open next questions name the omitted contracts and the two remaining rank-six caller budgets.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

Only a new research package is added. Archival intake is not scientific admission.
